cases.mutation: same factor ID; hypothetical alternative method output (synthetic observation substitution)
cases.detectability: NO_FACTOR_METHOD_ENFORCEMENT; changed result is visible, cause cannot be certified from method metadata
cases.proposed_requirement: immutable method_ref and authenticated method/config closure; unresolved method cannot claim valid new calculation
cases.scope: existing analyzer, synthetic substituted output; no production method replacement

cases.mutation: same next_3_5y_growth factor; requested horizon 1Q vs 5Y
cases.detectability: HORIZON_METADATA_VISIBLE; realized raw-map method/input horizon not authenticated
cases.proposed_requirement: pin economic input horizon separately from display/request horizon; changed computation horizon changes method/input-contract ref

cases.mutation: EPS branch vs current FCF/prior-revenue fallback; future fallback replacement unapproved
cases.detectability: RAW_INPUT_ARTIFACTS_CAN_HELP_RECONSTRUCT_BRANCH; observation has no selected fallback method identity
cases.proposed_requirement: ordered fallback methods plus selected branch ref and input lineage; actual replacement needs D3

cases.mutation: normalization branch change; same-version well-shaped calculation hash change
cases.detectability: BYTE_HASH_CAN_SHOW_DRIFT_IF_COMPARED_TO_TRUSTED_BYTES; inactive validator authenticates neither bytes nor allowed method/version relation
cases.proposed_requirement: pin normalization ref/parameters/direction/units and source closure; reject ID+version equivocation
cases.scope: actual DCF/PE branches and inactive sample structure; no normalization replacement

cases.mutation: new method/version result then historical record get
cases.detectability: SAVED_PAYLOAD_IMMUTABILITY_SUPPORTED; authenticated historical calculation-method replay not implemented
cases.proposed_requirement: historical snapshot exact refs/bytes; new linked snapshot for new method, never latest-method evaluation under old ID/version
cases.scope: in-memory immutable track record; file reload reviewed statically; archived executable replay NOT_RUN

cases.mutation: Personal/custom profile attempts method identity/version/normalization mutation
cases.proposed_requirement: reuse weight-only overrides and no-silent-rebase; immutable method/config refs outside profile editability
cases.scope: supported APIs only; arbitrary parameter dict construction is not scoring authority

checks.assertion: case1 accepts alternate synthetic factor output without method metadata
case1 coarse snapshot versions remain equal
case2 requested horizon does not select a different G method
case3 EPS and FCF branches share factor ID and explanatory label
case3 current FCF branch differs from EPS branch
case4 DCF and PE branches can emit indistinguishable observations
case4 same-version changed well-shaped hash remains SPEC_VALID
case5 immutable track record preserves historical payload
case5 FactorObservation contains no method/version dispatch key
case6 supported custom_profile API rejects three method/normalization keys
case6 WeightOverride is numeric weight only

claims_limit: Characterization PASS reproduces observed legacy behavior. It does not certify proposed runtime safety/implementation or approve any B decision.
